items.q: we had a little thing they called them the Cab Jivers, we used to go down front, play, Tyree Glenn, Milt Hinton, me, and Chu.

ctx.x: Do you remember the night that Dizzy got fired?

Yeah, I was right there in the band. See, we had a little thing they called them the Cab Jivers, we used to go down front, play, Tyree Glenn, Milt Hinton, me, and Chu. And four of us in front of the bandstand. Well while we would be in front, see, the band in back of us would be blacked out and there would be just pin spots on us. Well, Diz and Jonah and all them sitting back there in that bandstand, they all crazy back there, they used to get spitballs and throw at the back of our heads and everything, with a…
Milt Hinton claims that he did it.
